about: Batman abilities that are switched off while Spidey is on: any active instance whose class name starts with a listed prefix is cancelled (UGameplayAbility K2_CancelAbility) the frame it starts. Ability names come from the player pawn's AbilitySystemComponent (204 abilities, read live). Remapping the game's input contexts does not work here: LEGO Batman uses player-mappable key profiles that override them (tested 19:52, RMB still aimed). Story-scripted glides (GA_FollowGlideSpline) are left alone so missions cannot soft-lock.

rows.covers: aiming (RMB) and throwing/firing batarangs, BatClaw and other weapons; Q and R no longer fire Batman's gadgets
rows.verified: K2_CancelAbility on GA_Aim_Weapon_BatClaw ended the aim while RMB was held (19:55, screenshot aim3)

rows.covers: quick-gadget buttons and BatClaw slam (gel/spray/goggles item abilities are always-on listeners and are left alone)

rows.verified: log "applied grapple block" on every F6; the player tested R and R1 web launch with no grapnel firing (2026-10-10)
